_readme: Every source in this repo's pools that lets a character one-hand a two-handed weapon, wield an oversized one, or reduce the penalty for doing so. Hand-authored from a census of the pools (2026-08-17) and gated by Backend/scripts/gates/validate_gear_legality.py, which resolves every in_pool row against the file it names and PROVES every in_pool:false row really is absent -- so a gap that closes, or a name that gets respelled, fails loudly instead of turning into a silently dead branch. 'name' is the EXACT pool spelling, which is the field most likely to be wrong: the pool spells it 'Pikemans Training', not 'Pikeman's Training', and 'Titan Grip (Combat)', not 'Titan Grip'.

effects.one_hand: Wield a normally two-handed weapon in one hand, freeing the off hand for a shield.
effects.oversize: Wield a weapon built for a creature one or two size categories larger.
effects.penalty_reduction: Reduce the attack penalty an oversized weapon imposes.

enablers.name: Pikemans Training
enablers.note: The only feat in the whole pool that one-hands a two-hander for a shield user, and the cheapest rung on the D7 ladder: BAB +1 and nothing else. Wielded this way the weapon 'is treated in all ways as being a one-handed weapon'.

enablers.name: Quarterstaff Master
enablers.note: Real, but a poor grant: it needs Weapon Focus in one specific weapon as well as BAB +5, so granting it free means granting two feats to arm one quarterstaff build.

enablers.name: jotungrip (ex)
enablers.note: One of only two enablers KNOWN at gear time, because archetypes are set in phase_class_options and gear runs after it. Costs -2 on attack rolls, and the weapon still counts as one-handed for Power Attack and Strength-to-damage.

enablers.name: Twin_Thunder_Stance
enablers.note: General one-handing with no attack penalty, but a 3rd-level stance chosen in the Path of War phase, which runs AFTER gear.

enablers.name: Phalanx_Lancer
enablers.note: MISSED BY THE ORIGINAL CENSUS. A 1st-level Piercing Thunder stance that one-hands a two-handed discipline weapon specifically WHEN USING A SHIELD -- the shield-and-polearm case, with no prerequisite at all, and cheaper than Twin Thunder Stance.

enablers.name: Lighten Weapon
enablers.note: Kobold Press 3pp combat feat. NOT IN ANY POOL -- no row in feats_new.csv or Metzofitz_Feats.csv. Kept here so the gap is visible; sourcing it is a separate scrape and OGL job.

enablers.name: Titan Technique (Combat, Technique)
enablers.note: The +1 step, and the entry to the chain. Its own prerequisites are Power Attack and Str 15 -- NOT the Str 17 / BAB +4 the plan's census attributed to it, which belong to Titan Grip. Crucially it grants the same HANDEDNESS ('using the same handedness'), so it does not one-hand anything.

enablers.name: Titan Slayer (Combat)
enablers.note: The only +2 in the pool, and the reason weapon_size_damage.json's gap matters. Also grants +5 ft reach when the weapon is too large.

enablers.name: giant weapon wielder (ex)
enablers.note: The other enabler known at gear time, and the earliest: 1st level, replacing the fighter's 1st-level bonus feat.

enablers.name: massive weapons (ex)
enablers.note: MISSED BY THE ORIGINAL CENSUS. The Titan Mauler's own oversizing, at 3rd level -- so a Titan Mauler barbarian is BOTH a one-hander and an oversizer, and both facts are visible at gear time. Its penalty is 'increased by 4' rather than the usual 2.

enablers.name: Bigfolk Training

prerequisites.other: natural size Small or smaller, and a racial Strength penalty

enablers.note: MISSED BY THE ORIGINAL CENSUS. The small-race oversizer, and the only one with no attack penalty -- a Small character with it wields Medium weapons, which weapons_data.json already prints, so it needs no size table at all.

enablers.name: Equipment sphere advanced talent
enablers.note: Spheres of Might. NOT IN ANY POOL -- the 'Equipment' key in spheres_of_might_cleaned.json is a kit and gear list, not the talent tree. Kept visible; sourcing it is a separate scrape and OGL job.

enablers.name: Titan Grip (Combat)
enablers.note: Reduces the oversize penalty by 1, by another 1 at BAB +8 and every 4 thereafter, to a maximum reduction of 5. It is a PENALTY REDUCER and grants no size step of its own -- the census read it as a one-handing enabler, which it is not.

enablers.name: incredible heft (ex)
enablers.note: Reduces the penalty by 1 at 3rd level and by another 1 at 7th and every 4 levels thereafter, minimum 0. This is D10's named reduction.

false_positives.name: Effortless Lace
false_positives.why: Makes a one-handed weapon count as LIGHT. It does not touch two-handers, and in this repo it exists only as a name in Backend/json/foundry_item_names.json with no rules text attached.

false_positives.name: Scarlet_Einhander
false_positives.why: Scarlet Throne stance. Reads as one-handing ('holding his weapon low and one-handed') but only grants a shield bonus and bonus damage while wielding a melee weapon in one hand -- it does not change any weapon's handedness.

false_positives.name: Twin Thunders
false_positives.why: A real Ultimate Combat feat in feats_new.csv, and a near-miss for Twin Thunder Stance. It is a dwarf/gnome two-weapon-fighting feat about damage against giants, and enables nothing here.

false_positives.name: Titan Strike
false_positives.why: In feats_new.csv, and the fourth 'Titan' hit. It is a MYTHIC unarmed-strike feat, unrelated to the Titan Technique chain.

false_positives.name: armament shield
false_positives.why: Zweihander Sentinel warder archetype (Path of War). The INVERSE of an enabler -- it grants a shield bonus for wielding a two-hander, i.e. a reason to want no shield at all. Both Piercing Thunder stances above carry special notes about interacting with it.
